label: rem:classical-limit-topology-free
title: Topology-free surreal reformulation of the $q\to1$ limit
html:
Remark. Topology-free surreal reformulation of the q\to1 limit

Topology-free reformulation (forward reference). The classical limit functor uses a topological q \to 1 limit on the parameter space, which has obstructions (classical limit obstruction). The appendix replaces it with a literal evaluation in Conway's surreal field at q = 1 + \varepsilon, then takes the standard-part. Both replacements are conjectural; if they hold, they remove the need for any analytic machinery on the parameter space.
